answer: One agent, one registered athlete: the national sports federation signs each epoch challenge binding the agent's key to one athlete registration and competition record, re-checked against the federation database every epoch. A second key claiming the same athlete is refused — the federation holds the record. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 real athletes at roughly $200 each in membership, entry fees and medical clearance, about $200,000 — each one a living person who trains and races, leaving a plume of chalk dust, an ember of effort and a velvet finish-line photo no script can fake.
